repairs.attribution: FiveThirtyEight, Club soccer predictions match file (spi_matches.csv), via Item Response Warehouse, irw_competitions v7.1, DOI 10.57761/3r1w-t660
repairs.change: Year 2019 to 2020 in the 66 July fixtures of the pinned source blob

protocol.score: 100*(1-mean(normalized 1X2 Brier, O2.5 Brier, home O1.5 Brier, away O1.5 Brier))
protocol.training: current season to cutoff plus three preceding seasons; retain latest eligible version per fixture
protocol.b0: joint empirical scores of prior complete observed seasons in window; eligible data during warmup
protocol.b1: regularized time-decayed Dixon–Coles; hyperparameters fixed, shared across seasons
protocol.bootstrap_unit: season and official round; match-weighted paired score percentile interval
protocol.calibration: fixed 0.2-wide bins; clamped final bin includes 1

limitations: The final OpenFootball schedule does not reconstruct earlier schedule announcements or postponements without sidecar observations.
Publication and local receipt are unknown for results marked lag_assumption. Their delay from kickoff is a sensitivity assumption.
Historical football-score study only; 2025-26 was previously reviewed. No prospective blind result, personnel/news performance, executable prices, fees or ROI is measured.

reproduce.input: For a pinned data run, use football fetch INPUT --from-season FIRST --to-season LAST, using the input blob range above.
reproduce.command: pm861 --data-dir RUNTIME football backtest INPUT --from-season 2021-22 --to-season 2025-26 --horizons 1440 60 --bootstrap 2000 --seed 861 --summary-output SUMMARY.json --details MATCHES.jsonl
